onboarding.today: Browser signup form with reCAPTCHA v2 and an email confirmation link. No API signup.
blocks: reCAPTCHA on the only signup form
Email verification loop before the first key
onboarding.build: POST /v1/accounts with email+password, return API key in the response, no email verification. Gate abuse with IP reputation instead of CAPTCHA.

authentication.today: API keys generated in the dashboard; scoped read/write; no rotation endpoint.
blocks: Keys created by a human in the dashboard
authentication.build: POST /v1/api-keys and POST /v1/api-keys/{id}/rotate, callable with the key returned at signup.

purchasing.today: Self-serve pricing page; plan change redirects to Stripe hosted checkout.
blocks: POST /billing/change-plan returns checkout_url that needs a browser
purchasing.build: GET /v1/plans, Stripe SetupIntent to save a card once, then POST /v1/subscriptions with payment_method id. Publish pricing.json.

usage_monitoring.today: X-RateLimit-* headers on API responses; usage only in the dashboard.
usage_monitoring.build: GET /v1/usage with current-period totals and remaining quota.

self_management.today: Cancel and plan change in the dashboard only.
self_management.build: PATCH /v1/subscriptions/{id} for plan changes; DELETE for cancel.

dev_readiness.today: Structured JSON errors, OpenAPI published, test-mode keys. No idempotency keys, offset pagination.
dev_readiness.build: Idempotency-Key header on mutating endpoints; cursor pagination with has_more.

hard_blockers.text: reCAPTCHA on the only signup form stops every agent before an account exists.
Plan change returns a hosted checkout URL that requires a browser.

quick_wins.text: Return the first API key in the signup response instead of the dashboard.
Expose GET /v1/usage with the same numbers the dashboard shows.

roadmap: Remove CAPTCHA from the API signup path
